headline: Butterfield Bermuda: Power and Smotherman share 54-hole lead heading into final round
whyCareReason: Seamus Power and Austin Smotherman share the 54-hole lead as the final round begins Sunday at Port Royal.
teaser: Power and Smotherman co-lead after 54 holes. Blanchet, Hirata and Conners in pursuit Sunday.
story: The final round of the Butterfield Bermuda Championship gets underway Sunday, 25 October, at Port Royal Golf Course in Southampton, Bermuda. Following a testing third round marked by swirling Atlantic gusts, Ireland's Seamus Power and American Austin Smotherman emerged at the top of the leaderboard to share the 54-hole lead. Opening-round pacesetter Chandler Blanchet and Japan's Kensei Hirata remain well within striking distance alongside Canadian Corey Conners. With windy conditions forecast along the ocean cliffs, the battle for 500 FedExCup Fall points and the $1.08 million winner's share will come down to the final back nine.
stakes: The tournament champion will be crowned on Sunday afternoon with 500 FedExCup Fall points on the line.
rivalryAngle: Power and Smotherman defend a narrow edge over a packed field along the windy Southampton cliffs.
funFacts: Seamus Power and Austin Smotherman share the 54-hole lead heading into Sunday.
Chandler Blanchet and Kensei Hirata remain in close contention.
Port Royal Golf Course, Southampton. Purse $6 million, $1.08 million to the champion.
